explication: AxonHub is an AI gateway and administration platform. A client sends a compatible AI request to the server; the gateway translates it for a configured model provider, routes across channels with retry/failover, and returns the result. The repository also includes a web console for authentication, channel/model configuration, access control, analytics, and storage settings. The sampled pipeline and routing code support the runtime shape, while several server integrations and frontend features are represented by documented capabilities or directory-level paths; those links are marked unverified where their implementation was not shown.
